demonstration_summary.title: SLO burn assessment complete
demonstration_summary.summary: The walkthrough inspected the supplied SLO objective, error budget, burn rate, and supporting period.

checks.title: Objective
checks.detail: The target and rolling window were identified.

checks.title: Burn
checks.detail: The period driving accelerated consumption was inspected.

demonstration_summary.evidence: The SLO details and supporting signal establish the burn risk.

answer.evidence: The objective, budget, and burn-rate evidence support the urgency.

goals.title: Open the supplied SLO
goals.concept: An SLO combines an indicator, target, and time window.
goals.narration: Open the controller-provisioned SLO and inspect its indicator.
goals.reasoning: The objective and window define what good performance means.
goals.evidence: The SLO detail belongs to this run.
hints: Start with the supplied service objective.
Use the SLO overview and open its detail.
Open the run SLO; Show me can demonstrate it.

goals.title: Interpret the error budget
goals.concept: Remaining budget describes tolerance left, not the current rate of consumption.
goals.narration: Inspect objective, window, and remaining error budget.
goals.reasoning: A service may still meet its objective while becoming urgent.
goals.evidence: The budget state is visible for the rolling window.
hints: Distinguish the monthly objective from budget remaining.
Open error budget details; Show me can point them out.

goals.title: Inspect burn-rate evidence
goals.concept: Burn rate indicates how quickly the remaining tolerance is being consumed.
goals.narration: Inspect burn rate and its driving period.
goals.reasoning: Accelerated burn determines urgency before the objective is breached.
goals.evidence: The short period contains the corroborating failures.
hints: Now examine the speed of budget consumption.
Use the burn-rate panel and supporting period.
Inspect burn rate; Show me can demonstrate it.

goals.title: Submit the urgency assessment
goals.concept: Explain current compliance, burn risk, and the indicator period driving urgency.
goals.reasoning: Objective status alone is insufficient when burn is accelerating.
goals.evidence: The answer cites objective, budget, and burn evidence.
hints: State both current objective status and future risk.
Include the driving period and indicator evidence.
